title: ci: remove leftover Cirrus config
body:
Closes #2914.

Nothing outside these files points at them - no workflow, no Makefile target, no script under hack.

The one I was careful about is `contrib/cirrus/ostree_ext.dockerfile`, because there is a live `ostree_rs_ext` job in ci.yml and the names look related. That job runs in `quay.io/coreos-assembler/fcos-buildroot:testing-devel` and clones ostree-rs-ext at runtime, so it never uses the dockerfile.

I also checked Cirrus is not still reporting somewhere I was not looking. It posts nothing on recent PRs and nothing on the last 8 commits on main either, every check-run there comes from the github-actions app.

`.github/workflows/check_cirrus_cron.yml` is in the issue but is already gone. On coordinating with #2725, that one is already mergeable=false and has not been touched since February, so I do not think this changes much for it.
